source_name: NIST JARVIS-DFT documentation OPT/experimental bulk-modulus comparison table
source_citation: NIST JARVIS-DFT documentation, Comparison of bulk modulus K_V (GPa) from vdW-DF-optB88 (OPT) and experiments
retrieval_method: Byte-identical reuse of the source-checked 36-row worked bulk-modulus transcription
retrieval_timestamp_utc: unknown: the verification date 2026-07-11 was retained without a clock time
selection_rule: Reuse all 36 rows of the worked bulk-modulus fixture; no additional material selection, imputation, outcome ranking, or residual-based filtering
deduplication_rule: jvasp_id must be unique; the two distinct TiO2 structures remain distinct rows
known_source_dependence: Experimental source and protocol dependence is unresolved, and repeated formulas are not independent population draws
license_status: NIST public-information permission with attribution and disclaimer; not relicensed as MIT or CC BY
rights_basis: Unmarked information on the NIST JARVIS-DFT documentation site may be distributed or copied with appropriate credit under the NIST Copyrights & Disclaimers policy
redistribution_decision: Bundled as an attributed transcription under NIST public-information permission with the NIST disclaimer and non-endorsement boundary retained
study_role: external-data-conditioned sparse-determinant and matrix-free stress demonstrator
fixture_preparation: The same pinned and source-checked 36-row OPT/experimental fixture used by materials_bulk_modulus_samplers_jarvis
normalization: g_ref is evaluated at s=1 and unit operator coefficient, while OPT coefficients and experimental response ratios are median-normalized; near-unity s is therefore partly a coordinate convention, not a discovered materials scale
discrepancy_model: Fixed response-scaled generalized Gaussian loss for a demonstrator target; not a normalized generative likelihood or reported experimental uncertainty
target_measure: graph posterior over s with respect to ds
state_variable: per-material nondimensional scalar grid field u_j
determinant_route: separable spectrum and exact sparse LU; centered Gram/SLQ diagnostic over posterior support
matrix_free_conditioning: The Gram route squares the operator condition number: kappa(A^T A)=kappa(A)^2
independent_validation: exact sparse multivariate-Gaussian integration over every state field at finite penalty
claim_boundary: screened-Poisson/lattice surrogate only; no vector elasticity, elastic tensor, physical mesh, or transferable material scale is inferred
leakage_controls: operator coefficients and dependent response proxy use distinct external columns
a fixed reference Green response sets the response coordinate; it does not supply an independently observed physical truth
material-specific proxy variation comes only from the experimental column and is not generated from fitted forward outputs
finite-penalty validation integrates over state fields independently
